overviewHtml:
Platform owners often lack a clear picture of how Dynatrace is actually used. This dashboard shows real human usage, excluding system accounts and internal services.

What you get

  • Active users and adoption trends over time
  • Apps and capabilities gaining traction
  • Metrics powered by Grail audit telemetry
  • Default view of the last 30 days
prereqsHtml:
• A Dynatrace (Gen3) environment with Grail
  • The Dashboards app
  • Permission to query audit telemetry (dt.system.events, AUDIT_EVENT)
  • Default time range: last 30 days
setupHtml:
1. Open the Dashboards app in your Dynatrace environment.
  2. Use Upload to import Dynatrace Platform Adoption.json.
  3. That's it — the dashboard reads your own environment's audit telemetry live. There are no hard-coded IDs or environment-specific settings, so it works out of the box.
getStartedHtml:
You need a Dynatrace environment with Grail and permission to query audit telemetry.

  1. Open the Dashboards app
  2. Upload the dashboard JSON
  3. Review adoption across your environment
